title: Lazard's Realization Problem for N-Series: Bar Obstructions and Finite-Quotient Descent
summary: Lazard asked which $N$-series of a group arise from multiplicative filtrations of the integral group ring. Given an $N$-series $H_\bullet$ of a group $G$, let $A_\bullet$ be the filtration of the augmentation ideal spanned by products of elements $x-1$, $x\in H_a$, weighted by $a$. Every realizing filtration contains $A_\bullet$, so $H_\bullet$ is realizable exactly when the maps $H_n/H_{n+1}\to A_n/A_{n+1}$, $h\mapsto h-1$, are injective. We show that each kernel is the cokernel of an explicit map of normalized bar groups; for a finite group this makes realizability decidable by integer…
